chapter: Berlin and the Turner and Bryant bands
title: Charlie Turner's band, a quarrel with his best friend, and Willy Bryant
summary: His childhood German helped him get by; he left Charlie Turner's band by urgent request after a falling-out and then joined Willy Bryant's happy band.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: Now, you knew German from when you had worked in school?
Yeah, I learned German as a child, you know.

So I got by. Of course, it took me some time to get myself straight because I was (inaudible). So what happened was that -- Charlie Turner's band, I stayed with Charlie Turner's band. And then I stayed up there quite some time. And then I had a little difficulty with my best friend in the band and I retired from the band by request -- urgent request.
What'd you have a fist fight or something?
Well, it was something, I won't say.
So I retired from the band by request. Then I joined Willy Bryant. Now, that was a happy band.
